item.tib: bon khro dbal skor gsum gyi mkha' klong gsang ba'i yang bcud drag po dbal gyi mtshon cha b+hen ring drag po'i gtor zlog
item.coloph: mkha' klong gsang ba'i yang bcud drag po dbal gyis (gyi) b+han bzlog rta phu mang man bzlog dang bskang mdos bcas pa 'di ni/ bon khro dbal skor gsum gyis (gyi) mtshon cha rta phu brag nas bla ma rma ston gyis phyung pa lags so/ de la 'a zha blo gros rgyal mtshan gyis zhus/ de yi drung du nam mkha' rgyal mtshan gyis zhus/ de la gling smon lam rgyal mtshan rin chen gyis zhus/ de nas rim pa brgyud nas bdag la'o/ bon bstan dar zhing rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog/
